Enum Class MessageType

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Enum<MessageType>
it.polimi.ingsw.network.utils.message.MessageType
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Comparable<MessageType>, Constable
public enum MessageType extends Enum<MessageType>
Exhaustive list of message types exchanged over the TCP socket. Direction conventions: C→S client sends to server S→C server sends to client ↔ both directions
